conditions: The query description is accepted and used without a protocol-level dataset override.
limitations: The result concerns the default graph of that described dataset. Named graph contents, service selection, resource retrieval, protocol overrides and endpoint defaults are separate.

triggers: Issuer erratum, changed source representation, or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: A SPARQL 1.1 query dataset description containing at least one FROM NAMED clause and no FROM clause yields an empty default graph when that description is used.
